channel.title: Lecture Notes on MIT OpenCourseWare
channel.description: Recent content in Lecture Notes on MIT OpenCourseWare

item.title: l01.pdf
item.description: This resource provides information on thermodynamics, laws of thermodynamics, definitions, states of system equilibrium and notations.

item.title: l02.pdf
item.description: This resource provides information on work, heat, heat capacity and equivalence of heat and work.

item.title: l03.pdf
item.description: This resource provides information on isothermal gas expansion, internal energy and related constraints, and Joule Free expansion of a gas.

item.title: l04.pdf
item.description: This resource provides information on reversible adiabatic expansion of an ideal gas, and irreversible expansion of an ideal gas against a constant external pressure.

item.title: l05.pdf
item.description: This resource provides information about calculating enthalpy changes for every reaction.

item.title: l06.pdf
item.description: This resource provides information about the Second law of thermodynamics, and two classical statements for the law: Kelvin and Clausius.

item.title: l07.pdf
item.description: This resource provides examples of spontaneous processes and further information about Boltzmann equation of entropy.

item.title: l08.pdf
item.description: This resource provides information about fundamental equations, criteria for spontaneous change, and Maxwell relations.

item.title: l09.pdf
item.description: This resource provides information on the topics: Gibbs free energy, multicomponent systems, partial molar quantities, and the chemical potential.

item.title: l10.pdf
item.description: This resource provides information on ideal gases, example of effect of total pressure, and Le Chatelier’s principle.

item.title: l11.pdf
item.description: This resource provides information about temperature dependence of equilibrium constant and Le Chatelier’s principle of temperature, along with an example.

item.title: l12.pdf
item.description: This resource provides information about the topic - equilibrium: application to drug design, and the relation of equilibrium constant and Gibbs free energy.

item.title: l13.pdf
item.description: This resource provides information about statistical mechanics, probability and combinotorics, and a description of Boltzmann equation.

item.title: l14.pdf
item.description: This resource provides information about derivation of Boltzmann distribution law, and the partition function.

item.title: l15.pdf
item.description: This resource provides information about partition functions for independent and distinguishable particles.

item.title: l16.pdf
item.description: This resource provides information about absolute entropies and third law of thermodynamics.

item.title: l17.pdf
item.description: This resource provides information about phase equilibria in a one component system, phase diagrams, Clapeyron equation, and phase rule.

item.title: l18.pdf
item.description: This resource provides information on Clausius Clapeyron equation and condensed phase equilibria, and equilibrium between gas/liquid or gas/solid (gas/condensed phase).

item.title: l21.pdf
item.description: This resource provides information about regular solutions, vapour pressure, surface tension and interfacial tension.

item.title: l22.pdf
item.description: This resource provides information on surface tension, osmotic pressure and colligative property.

item.title: l23.pdf
item.description: This resource provides information about osmotic pressure, phase equilibria, and solute in phase partitioning.

item.title: l24.pdf
item.description: This resource provides information about simple polymers, configurational entropy of polymers, and polymer chain conformation and size.

item.title: l25.pdf
item.description: This resource provides information about random flight, freely jointed chain, radius of gyration, and probability states for ideal chain.

item.title: l26.pdf
item.description: This resource provides information about elasticity, and retractive force.

item.title: l27.pdf
item.description: This resource provides information about rubber elasticity - network of chains, crosslinked and additional materials on the topic: electrolyte solutions.

item.title: l28.pdf
item.description: This resource provides information about compressive resistance of cartilage, Gibbs-Duhem equation and ionization of weak acids.

item.title: l29.pdf
item.description: This resource provides a review of Gibbs-Duhem equation, electrochemical potential, and Debye length.

item.title: l30.pdf
item.description: This resource provides information on weak acids, polyprotic acids, polyelectrolytes and effects of electrolyte.

item.title: l31.pdf
item.description: This resource provides information on the topics - cooperative transitions 1: DNA hybridization.
